301.sa: गुहं प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः। वर्षरात्रोषितो रामः कामशोकाभिपीडितः4.30.1।। पाण्डुरं गगनं दृष्ट्वा विमलं चन्द्रमण्डलम्। शारदीं रजनीं चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्नानुलेपनाम्4.30.2।। कामवृत्तं च सुग्रीवं नष्टां च जनकात्मजाम्। बुद्ध्वा कालमतीतं च मुमोह परमातुरः4.30.3।।
301.e: While Sugriva was in his residence, Rama was (in Prasravana mountain) spending his rainy nights tormented by passion (for Sita). Sugriva was engaged in love, forgetting the time fixed for taking up the search for Sita. When the sky became clear of clouds after the rainy season, Rama sat gazing at the clear autumnal Moon's orb. He was besmeared with moonlight and felt perturbed as time was running out. And then fell into a swoon. (only a few months remained for the completion of the exile and Bharata will put an end to himself if Rama does not return to Ayodhya on the stipulated day. This worried Rama.)

301.sa: गुहं प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः। वर्षरात्रोषितो रामः कामशोकाभिपीडितः4.30.1।। पाण्डुरं गगनं दृष्ट्वा विमलं चन्द्रमण्डलम्। शारदीं रजनीं चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्नानुलेपनाम्4.30.2।। कामवृत्तं च सुग्रीवं नष्टां च जनकात्मजाम्। बुद्ध्वा कालमतीतं च मुमोह परमातुरः4.30.3।।

Sugriva was engaged in love, forgetting the time fixed for taking up the search for Sita. When the sky became clear of clouds after the rainy season, Rama sat gazing at the clear autumnal Moon's orb. He was besmeared with moonlight and felt perturbed as time was running out. And then fell into a swoon. (only a few months remained for the completion of the exile and Bharata will put an end to himself if Rama does not return to Ayodhya on the stipulated day. This worried Rama.)

301.e: While Sugriva was in his residence, Rama was (in Prasravana mountain) spending his rainy nights tormented by passion (for Sita). Sugriva was engaged in love, forgetting the time fixed for taking up the search for Sita. When the sky became clear of clouds after the rainy season, Rama sat gazing at the clear autumnal Moon's orb. He was besmeared with moonlight and felt perturbed as time was running out. And then fell into a swoon. (only a few months remained for the completion of the exile and Bharata will put an end to himself if Rama does not return to Ayodhya on the stipulated day. This worried Rama.)

301.sa: स तु संज्ञामुपागम्य मुहूर्तान्मतिमान्पुनः। मनस्स्थामपि वैदेहीं चिन्तयामास राघवः4.30.4।।
301.e: Gaining back the senses after a while, wise Rama started thinking about Vaidehi, who remained in his heart.

301.sa: आसीनः पर्वतस्याग्रे हेमधातुविभूषिते। शारदं गगनं दृष्ट्वा जगाम मनसा प्रियाम्4.30.5।।
301.e: Sitting on top of the mountain shining with gold and minerals, Rama  gazed at the pleasant autumnal sky and started thinking of his beloved.

301.sa: दृष्ट्वा च विमलं व्योम गतविद्युद्वलाहकम्। सारसारावसङ्घुष्ठं विललापार्तया गिरा4.30.6।।
301.e: Looking at the sky rid of clouds and lightning, filled with the sounds of flocks of sarasa birds, Rama cried in a pitiable state.

301.sa: सारसारावसन्नादैस्सारसारवनादिनी। याऽऽश्रमे रमते बाला साऽद्य मे रमते कथम्4.30.7।।
301.e: 'How will the young lady (Sita) whose voice is like the sarasa bird's, who was revelling, listening to its sweet cackle at the hermitage be living now?

301.sa: पुष्पितांश्चासनान् दृष्ट्वा काञ्चनानिव निर्मलान्। कथं सा रमते बाला पश्यन्ती मामपश्यती4.30.8।।
301.e: 'How will my beloved wife feel on seeing the asana flowers which are as pure as gold, when she does not find me anywhere?

301.sa: या पुरा कलहंसानां स्वरेण कलभाषिणी। बुध्यते चारुसर्वाङ्गी साऽद्य मे बुद्ध्यते कथम्4.30.9।।
301.e: 'How will my Sita with her charming limbs and sweet words, who used to get up from sleep by the cackle of swans, wake up now?

301.sa: निस्वनं चक्रवाकानां निशम्य नहचारिणाम्। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षी कथमेषा भविष्यति4.30.10।।
301.e: 'How will that  lady with large, pale white eyes sustain her life now, since she is used to listening to the sweet notes of chakravaka birds, who were her companions?

301.sa: सरांसि सरितो वापीः काननानि वनानि च। तां विना मृगशाबाक्षीं चरन्नाद्य सुखं लभे4.30.11।।
301.e: 'Even though I am wandering by lakes, rivers, wells, forests and groves,I am not happy without that fawneyed lady.

301.sa: अपि तां मद्वियोगाच्छ सौकुमार्याच्च भामिनीम्। सुदूरं पीडयेत्कामश्शरद्गुणनिरन्तरः4.30.12।।
301.e: 'I think even the charm of autumn must be always tormenting that lovely lady, as she is very far from me. She is too delicate to suffer the agony of separation.'

301.sa: एवमादि नरश्रेष्ठो विललाप नृपात्मजः। विहङ्ग इव सारङ्गस्सलिलं त्रिदशेश्वरात्4.30.13।।
301.e: Thus the best among the princes wailed just as chakrabaka laments for water from Indra, lord of the gods.

301.sa: ततश्चञ्चूर्य रम्येषु फलार्थी गिरिसानुषु। ददर्श पर्युपावृत्तो लक्ष्मीवान्लक्ष्मणोऽग्रजम्4.30.14।।
301.e: Graceful Lakshmana returned after going round and round the beautiful mountain slopes for fruits and saw his brother.

301.sa: तं चिन्तया दुस्सहया परीतं विसंज्ञमेकं विजने मनस्वी। भ्रातुर्विषादात्परितापदीनः समीक्ष्य सौमित्रिरुवाच रामम्4.30.15।।
301.e: Observing Rama who had lost his senses, lying alone in unbearable agony, venerable Lakshmana became sad and miserable and spoke to his brother:

301.sa: किमार्य कामस्य वशंगतेन किमात्मपौरुष्यपराभवेन। अयं सदा संह्रियते समाधिः किमत्र योगेन निवर्तितेन4.30.16।।
301.e: 'O revered brother why do you succumb to passion and loss of selfconfidence? Why is the usual composure of your mind withdrawn? Why do you desist from yaga?

301.sa: क्रियाभियोगं मनसः प्रसादं समाधियोगानुगतं च कालम्। सहायसामर्थ्यमदीनसत्त्वः स्वकर्म हेतुं च कुरुष्व हेतुम्4.30.17।।
301.e: 'You are an undaunted warrior. Take to the path of action. Resort to samadhiyoga or meditation and regain the serenity of mind. Make the strength of your effort the source of your success.

301.sa: न जानकी मानव वंशनाथ त्वया सनाथा सुलभा परेण। न चाग्निचूडां ज्वलितामुपेत्य न दह्यते वीर वरार्ह कच्छित्4.30.18।।
301.e: 'O lord of the human race O worthy hero when you are the protector, Janaki cannot be retained by any one easily just as burning fire after it reaches its full height cannot be retained by any one.'

301.sa: सलक्षणं लक्ष्मणमप्रधृष्यं स्वभावजं वाक्यमुवाच रामः। हितं च पथ्यं च नयप्रसक्तं ससाम धर्मार्थसमाहितं च4.30.19।।
301.e: Rama said to Lakshmana, an unassailable warrior with auspicious signs, that what he had spoken was natural, beneficial, wise and useful.It is in accordance with Sama Veda and the science of statecraft, well established in dharma and artha.

301.sa: निस्संशयं कार्यमवेक्षितव्यं क्रियाविशेषोऽह्यनुवर्तितव्यः। ननु प्रवृत्तस्य दुरासदस्य कुमार कार्यस्य फलं च चिन्त्यम्4.30.20।।
301.e: 'My dear, there is no doubt that I have to consider the work (ahead), give special attention to follow up. Surely I need to think over this herculian task and its achievement'.

301.sa: अथ पद्मपलाशाक्षीं मैथिलीमनुचिन्तयन्। उवाच लक्ष्मणं रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता4.30.21।।
301.e: Then falling back on the memory of Maithili, the lady with eyes like lotus petals, he said to Lakshmana with parched lips:

301.sa: तर्पयित्वा सहस्राक्षस्सलिलेन वसुन्धराम्। निर्वर्तयित्वा सस्यानि कृतकर्मा व्यवस्थितः4.30.22।।
301.e: 'Having satisfied the earth with abundant rain water and having fulfilled the task of ripening the crops, the thousandeyed Indra has done his duty, has settled down now.

301.sa: स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषाश्शैलद्रुमपुरोगमाः। विसृज्य सलिलं मेघाः परिश्रान्ता नृपात्मज4.30.23।।
301.e: 'O prince having discharged their water the clouds (after the rains) are exhausted. They are moving now over trees and mountains, making deep and pleasant sounds.

301.sa: नीलोत्पलदलश्यामाश्श्यामीकृत्वा दिशो दश। विमदा इव मातङ्गाश्शान्तवेगाः पयोधराः4.30.24।।
301.e: 'The clouds, which were dark till now like the blue lotus petals darkening all the ten directions  are like elephants free from all intoxication as their fury is abated৷৷

301.sa: जलगर्भा महामेघा कुटजार्जुनगन्धिनः। चरित्वा विरतास्सौम्य वृष्टिवातास्समुद्यताः4.30.25।।
301.e: 'O dear the moist winds have ceased to blow as before and are carrying the fragrance of kutaja and arjuna flowers.

301.sa: घनानां वारणानां च मयूराणां च लक्ष्मण। नादः प्रस्रवणानां च प्रशान्तस्सहसाऽनघ4.30.26।।
301.e: 'O sinless Lakshmana the rumblings of heavy clouds, the trumpeting of elephants, the cry of peacocks and the sound of waterfalls have become suddenly stilled.

301.sa: अभिवृष्टा महामेघैर्निर्मलाश्चित्रसानवः। अनुलिप्ता इवाऽभान्ति गिरयश्चित्रदीप्तिभिः4.30.27।।
301.e: 'The mountain slopes, having  been washed by the showers of rain on all sides, are cleansed. They are shining in variegated colours and look as though the mountain peaks are smeared with glowing colours (of minerals).

301.sa: शाखासु सप्तच्छदपादपानां प्रभासु तारार्कनिशाकराणाम्। लीलासु चैवोत्तम वारणानां श्रियं विभज्याद्य शरत्प्रवृत्ता4.30.28।।
301.e: 'The autumn has set in, manifesting its grace on the branches of saptachada trees(sevenleafed banana plant) through the radiance of stars, Sun and Moon and through the sports of excellent elephants.

301.sa: सम्प्रत्यनेकाश्रय चित्रशोभा लक्ष्मीश्शरत्कालगुणोपनीता। सूर्याग्रहस्तप्रतिबोधितेषु पद्माकरेष्वभ्यधिकं विभाति4.30.29।।
301.e: 'From the beauty of autumn manifested in a variety of ways on the clusters of lotuses, touched by the Sun, it seems the goddess of wealth shines and shines effulgently. (The lotus is goddess Laxmi's favourite flower)

301.sa: सप्तच्छदानां कुसुमोपगन्धी षट्पादबृन्दैरनुगीयमानः। मत्तद्विपानां पवनोऽनुसारी दर्पं विनेष्यन्नधिकं करोति।।4.30.30।।
301.e: 'The wind carries the fragrance of saptachada flowers. Attracted by the fragrance, swarms of bees come humming. The pride of the elephants in rut increases.

301.sa: अभ्यागतैश्चारुविशालपक्षै स्सरःप्रियैः पद्मरजोवकीर्णैः। महानदीनां पुलिनोपयातैः क्रीडन्ति हंसास्सह चक्रवाकैः4.30.31।।
301.e: 'The swans have come face to face with chakravaka birds. They have newly arrived.  Lovers of lakes, they are shaking the pollen of lotuses on their lovely wide wings and have settled on the sandy bankssporting.

301.sa: मदप्रगल्भेषु च वारणेषु गवां समूहेषु च दर्पितेषु। प्रसन्नतोयासु च निम्नगासु विभाति लक्ष्मीर्बहुधा विभक्ता4.30.32।।
301.e: 'Goddess Laxmi with her scattered self shines there among the proud elephants, among herds of excited bulls and among streams with clear water.

301.sa: नभस्समीक्ष्याम्बुधरैर्विमुक्तं विमुक्तबर्हाभरणा वनेषु। प्रियास्वसक्ता विनिवृत्तशोभा गतोत्सवा ध्यानपरा मयूराः4.30.33।।
301.e: 'The sky is free from clouds. The peacocks have shed their ornamental plumes. They have lost interest in their beloveds. With their glory withdrawn, the peacocks are devoid of happiness and absorbed in the thought of the clouds.

301.sa: मनोज्ञगन्धैः प्रियकैरनल्पैः पुष्पातिभारावनताग्रशाखैः। सुवर्णगौरैर्नयनाभिरामै रुद्योतितानीव वनान्तराणि4.30.34।।
301.e: 'The forests are delightful to the eyes, as if illuminated by a large number of goldencoloured, finesmelling priyaka branches bent under the heavy loads of flowers.

301.sa: प्रियान्वितानां नलिनीप्रियाणां वने रतानां कुसुमोद्धतानाम्। मदोत्कटानां मदलालसानां गजोत्तमानां गतयोऽद्य मन्दाः4.30.35।।
301.e: 'Lordly elephants accompanied by their dear female mates, fond of lotus ponds  and woods are out to enjoy the sweet smell of the blossoms of saptachada  and excited by passion and longing for sexual union are moving slowly.

301.sa: व्यभ्रं नभश्शस्त्रविधौतवर्णं कृशप्रवाहानि नदीजलानि। कह्लारशीताः पवनाः प्रवान्ति तमोविमुक्ताश्च दिशः प्रकाशाः4.30.36।।
301.e: 'Cleared of the black clouds, the sky is shining like a polished weapon. The river waters flow feebly. Winds blowing over white lotuses feel cool. All quarters clear of darkness are shining.

301.sa: सूर्यातपक्रामणनष्टपङ्का भूमिश्चिरोदधाटितसान्द्ररेणुः। अन्योन्यवैरेणसमायुताना मुद्योगकालोऽद्य नराधिपानाम्4.30.37।।
शरद्गुणाप्यायितरूपशोभाः प्रहर्षिताः पांशुसमुत्क्षिताङ्गाः। मदोत्कटास्सम्प्रति युद्धलुब्धा वृषा गवां मध्यगता नदन्ति4.30.38।।
301.e: 'The bulls surrounded by cows are bellowing with the dust settled on their limbs. Excited by passion they are happy, ready to fight. They look attractive, blessed by the attributes of Autumn.

301.sa: समन्मथं तीव्रगतानुरागाः कुलान्विता मन्दगतिं करिण्यः। मदान्वितं सम्परिवार्य यान्तं वनेषु भर्तारमनुप्रयान्ति4.30.39।।
301.e: 'The female elephants of good breed, deeply passionate, gather round and follow their intoxicated lord moving slowly through the forest.

301.sa: त्यक्त्वा वराण्यात्मविभूषणानि बर्हाणि तीरोपगता नदीनाम्। निर्भर्त्स्यमाना इव सारसौघैः प्रयान्ति दीना विमदा मयूराः4.30.40।।
301.e: 'The peacocks have shed their ornamental wear, their plumes. They are moving on the river banks miserably, devoid of high spirit as if they are being taunted by flocks of sarasa birds (who are highspinted and cheerful).

301.sa: वित्रास्य कारण्डवचक्रवाका न्महारवैर्भिन्नकटा गजेन्द्राः। सरस्सु बद्धाम्बुजभूषणेषु विक्षोभ्य विक्षोभ्य जलं पिबन्ति4.30.41।।
301.e: 'Excellent elephants in rut, with ichor exuding from their temples trumpet, frightening the ducks and chakravaka birds in the water. Strirring the water in the lakes, ornamented with lotuses, they drink it.

301.sa: व्यपेतपङ्कासु सवालुकासु प्रसन्नतोयासु सगोकुलासु। ससारसारावनिनादितासु नदीषु हृष्टा निपतन्ति हंसाः4.30.42।।
301.e: 'The swans are full of joy, flocking on the sand banks of rivers crowded with cows where the water is pure and devoid of mud. The rivers are full of sarasa birds and swans who are singing delightfully.

301.sa: नदीघनप्रस्रवणोदकाना मतिप्रवृद्धानिलबर्हिणानाम्। प्लवङ्गमानां च गतोत्सवानां द्रुतं रवास्सम्प्रति सम्प्रणष्टाः4.30.43।।
301.e: 'Suddenly the turbulent sounds of the river waters, waterfalls and thunderclouds have stopped. The peacoks having lost the pleasure of blowing winds lost their excitement. The croaking of frogs is silent.

301.sa: अनेकवर्णास्सुविनष्टकाया नवोदितेष्वम्बुधरेषु नष्टाः। क्षुधार्दिता घोरविषा बिलेभ्य श्चिरोषिता विप्रसरन्ति सर्पाः4.30.44।।
301.e: 'With no new rainclouds (in the sky), venomous, multicoloured serpents crawl out of the anthills with emacited (hybernated) bodies, troubled by hunger due to long confinement.

301.sa: चञ्चच्चन्द्रकरस्पर्शहर्षोन्मीलिततारका। अहो रागवती सन्ध्या जहाति स्वयमम्बरम्4.30.45।।
301.e: 'While the stars appear with the soothing touch of the Moon's beams, this ruddy twilight is quitting the sky on her own.

301.sa: रात्रिश्शशाङ्कोदितसौम्यवक्त्रा तारागणोन्मीलितचारुनेत्रा। ज्योत्स्नांशुकप्रावरणा विभाति नारीव शुक्लांशुकसंवृताङ्गी4.30.46।।
301.e: 'The night appears like a lady with a sweet face lit up by the rising Moon, her beautiful eyes opened up by stars, her body draped in the robe of white Moon light.

301.sa: विपक्वशालिप्रसवानि भुक्त्वा प्रहर्षिता सारसचारुपङ्क्तिः। नभस्समाक्रामति शीघ्रवेगाः वातावधूता ग्रथितेव माला4.30.47।।
301.e: 'Driven by the wind, the lovely sarasa birds, after eating ripened grains from paddy fields happily fly the sky in rows like a garland at great speed.

301.sa: सुप्तैकहंसं कुमुदैरुपेतं महाह्रदस्थं सलिलं विभाति। घनैर्विमुक्तं निशि पूर्णचन्द्रं तारागणाकीर्णमिवान्तरिक्षम्4.30.48।।
301.e: 'With a single swan in sleep night lotuses blooming around it, the water in the big tank appear like the sky free from clouds with the full Moon and clusters of stars scattered. (The swan is the moon, the lotuses the stars and the clean pond the sky).

301.sa: प्रकीर्णहंसाकुलमेखलानां प्रबुद्धपद्मोत्पलमालिनीनाम्। वाप्युत्तमानामधिकाऽद्य लक्ष्मी र्वराङ्गनानामिव भूषितानाम्4.30.49।।
301.e: 'Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth (also of autumn) appears decorated with deep wells like an excellent lady with swans as girdles and blooming lotuses and lilies as  garlands.

301.sa: वेणुस्वनव्यञ्जिततूर्यमिश्रः प्रत्यूषकालानिलसम्प्रवृद्धः। सम्मूर्छितो गर्गरगोवृषाणा मन्योन्यमापूरयतीव शब्दः4.30.50।।
301.e: 'The whistling of bamboos enhanced by the wind in the early morning, and the bellowing of bulls echoing in the caves supplement each other as it were.

301.sa: नवैर्नदीनां कुसुमप्रभासै र्व्याधूयमानैर्मृदुमारुतेन। धौतामलक्षौमपटप्रकाशैः कूलानि काशैरुपशोभितानि4.30.51।।
301.e: 'The river banks shining with fresh white flowers of kasa reeds swayed by the gentle breeze silken look like a lady wrapped in white silk.

301.sa: वनप्रचण्डा मधुपानशौण्डाः प्रियान्विताष्षट्चरणाः प्रह्रृष्टाः। वनेषु मत्ताः पवनानुयात्रां कुर्वन्ति पद्मासनरेणुगौराः4.30.52।।
301.e: 'The butterflies glitter around in the forest fearlessly showing their skill in drinking honey, with their backs turned white with the dust of pollen grains from the lotus cups. They follow the wind along with their loved ones in the forest.

301.sa: जलं प्रसन्नं कुमुदं प्रभासं क्रौञ्चस्वनश्शालिवनं विपक्वम्। मृदुश्च वायुर्विमलश्च चन्द्र श्शंसन्ति वर्षव्यपनीतकालम्4.30.53।।
301.e: 'The fresh blooms of night lotuses, the cackle of krauncha birds, fully ripened fields of paddy, the gentle breeze and the bright Moon indicate the coming to an end of the rainy season and setting in of autum.

301.sa: मीनोपसन्दर्शितमेखलानां नदीवधूनां गतयोऽद्य मन्दाः। कान्तोपभुक्तालसगामिनीनां प्रभातकालेष्विव कामिनीनाम्4.30.54।।
301.e: 'Now the riverbrides, displaying their girdles of fish, have  slowed down like the gait of sensuous ladies in the early morning, exhausted by sexual pleasures.

301.sa: सचक्रवाकानि सशैवलानि काशैर्दुकूलैरिव संवृतानि। सपत्रलेखानि सरोचनानि वधूमुखानीव नदीमुखानि4.30.55।।
301.e: 'Crowded with chakravaka birds and green moss, and covered with kasa reeds like silken veils, the river banks appear like the face of the bride decorated with designs of green leaves and gorochana tilaka.

301.sa: प्रफुल्लबाणासनचित्रितेषु प्रहृष्टषट्पादनिकूजितेषु। गृहीतचापोद्यतचण्डदण्डः प्रचण्डचारोऽद्य वनेषु कामः4.30.56।।
301.e: 'Now Cupid is moving unobstructed showing his power by holding his bow indicating strict punishment to those separated from their beloveds in the forests with bana and asana flowers in bloom and bees humming happily.

301.sa: लोकं सुवृष्ट्या परितोषयित्वा नदीस्तटाकानि च पूरयित्वा। निष्पन्नसस्यां वसुधां च कृत्वा त्यक्त्वा नभस्तोयधराः प्रणष्टाः4.30.57।।
301.e: 'Having showered heavy rains, and filling tanks and rivers, and producing bumper crops on the earth the clouds have disapeared.

301.sa: दर्शयन्ति शरन्नद्यः पुलिनानि शनैः शनैः। नवसङ्गमसव्रीडा जघनानीव योषितः4.30.58।।
301.e: 'Just as bashful young brides show their loins slowly during their first sexual meet the rivers start showing their sandy banks slowly in autumn.

301.sa: प्रसन्नसलिलास्सौम्य कुररीभिर्विनादिताः। चक्रवाकगणाकीर्णा विभान्ति सलिलाशयाः4.30.59।।
301.e: 'O gentle Lakshmana the pure water in the tanks and sweet sounds of flocks of female kurari birds and chakravakas there are splendid.

301.sa: असनास्सप्तपर्णाश्च कोविदाराश्च पुष्पिताः। दृश्यन्ते बन्धुजीवाश्च श्यामाश्च गिरिसानुषु4.30.60।।
301.e: 'The asanas, saptaparna, kovida and bandhujeeva trees and shyama creepers are seen in full bloom on the mountain slopes.

301.sa: हंससारसचक्राह्वैः कुररैश्च समन्ततः। पुलिनान्यवकीर्णानि नदीनां पश्य लक्ष्मण4.30.61।।
301.e: 'Lakshmana look at the swans, sarasas, chakravakas and kurara birds scattered all over the river banks.

301.sa: अन्योन्यबद्धवैराणां जिगीषूणां नृपात्मज। उद्योगसमयस्सौम्य पार्थिवानामुपस्थितः4.30.62।।
301.e: 'O handsome prince the time has come for making expeditions by kings against the enemies waiting for victory.

301.sa: इयं सा प्रथमा यात्रा पार्थिवानां नृपात्मज न च पश्यामि सुग्रीवमुद्योगं वा तथाविधम्4.30.63।।
301.e: 'O prince this is time for the first expedition (of the year) by kings. I do not find Sugriva making effort in that direction.

301.sa: चत्वारो वार्षिका मासा गता वर्षशतोपमाः। मम शोकाभिभूतस्य सौम्य सीतामपश्यतः4.30.64।।
301.e: 'O gentle one, the four months of rainy season are spent without seeing Sita. It is equal to a hundred years for my griefstricken heart.

301.sa: चक्रवाकीव भर्तारं पृष्ठतोऽनुगता वनम्। विषमं दण्डकारण्यमुद्यानमिव याऽगता4.30.65।।
301.e: 'Just as a female chakravaka follows the male, Sita followed her husband into this dense Dandaka forest as though it is a pleasuregarden.

301.sa: प्रियाविहीने दुःखार्ते हृतराज्ये विवासिते। कृपां न कुरुते राजा सुग्रीवो मयि लक्ष्मण4.30.66।।
301.e: 'O Lakshmana king Sugriva shows no mercy on one, who is griefstricken, separated from his wife, and banished from the kingdom.

301.sa: अनाथो हृतराज्योऽयं रावणेन च धर्षितः। दीनो दूरगृहः कामी मां चैव शरणं गतः4.30.67।। इत्येतैः कारणैस्सौम्य सुग्रीवस्य दुरात्मनः। अहं वानरराजस्य परिभूतः परन्तप4.30.68।।
301.e: 'O gentle one although I am a vanquisher of foes, this evilminded king of monkeys is slighting me because I am away from home, I have lost my kingdom, I am outraged by Ravana, I am miserable and lovesick and I have sought his help.

301.sa: अनाथो हृतराज्योऽयं रावणेन च धर्षितः। दीनो दूरगृहः कामी मां चैव शरणं गतः4.30.67।। इत्येतैः कारणैस्सौम्य सुग्रीवस्य दुरात्मनः। अहं वानरराजस्य परिभूतः परन्तप4.30.68।।
301.e: 'O gentle one although I am a vanquisher of foes, this evilminded king of monkeys is slighting me because I am away from home, I have lost my kingdom, I am outraged by Ravana, I am miserable and lovesick and I have sought his help.

301.sa: स कालं परिसङ्ख्याय सीतायाः परिमार्गणे। कृतार्थस्समयं कृत्वा दुर्मतिर्नावबुध्यते4.30.69।।
301.e: 'The evilminded Sugriva, having fulfilled his objective, does not realise that he has made a promise to me and has reached the time set for the search of Sita.

301.sa: त्वं च किष्किन्धां प्रविश्य ब्रूहि वानरपुङ्गवम्। मूर्खं ग्राम्यसुखे सक्तं सुग्रीवं वचनान्मम4.30.70।।
301.e: 'Go to Kishkinda and speak (on my behalf ) to that  fool, Sugriva, the chief of monkeys who is revelling in habitual sensual pleasures

301.sa: अर्थिनामुपपन्नानां पूर्वं चाप्युपकारिणाम्। आशां संश्रुत्य यो हन्ति स लोके पुरुषाधमः4.30.71।।
301.e: 'He who, having promised to his friend to grant his desire and who, having been obliged, fails to implement the promise, is the lowest on earth.

301.sa: शुभं वा यदि वा पापं यो हि वाक्यमुदीरितम्। सत्येन प्रतिगृह्णाति स वीरः पुरुषोत्तमः4.30.72।।
301.e: '(On the other hand) he who honours his promise, whether good or bad, is truly heroic, the best of men.'

301.sa: कृतार्था ह्यकृतार्थानां मित्राणां न भवन्ति ये। तान्मृतानपि क्रव्यादाः कृतघ्नान्नोपभुञ्जते4.30.73।।
301.e: 'Even the carnivorous animals dislike to eat the body of such ungrateful men who do not help their friends even though they have received help and have achieved their objective.'

301.sa: नूनं काञ्चनपृष्ठस्य विकृष्टस्य मया रणे। द्रष्टुमिच्छति चापस्य रूपं विद्युद्गणोपमम्4.30.74।।
301.e: 'Surely he wishes to see the form of my bow inlaid with gold bent by me to its full length, looking like a streak of lightning.

301.sa: घोरं ज्यातलनिर्घोषं क्रुद्धस्य मम संयुगे। निर्घोषमिव वज्रस्य पुनस्संश्रोतुमिच्छसि4.30.75।।
301.e: 'Perhaps he wants once again to hear when enraged in a combat, the dreadful twang of my bow, resembling the peal of a thunderbolt .

301.sa: काममेवंगतेऽप्यस्य परिज्ञाते पराक्रमे। त्वत्सहायस्य मे वीर न चिन्ता स्यान्नृपात्मज4.30.76।।
301.e: 'O prince knowing my valour fully welI, and knowing that you are here to help me he is unhesitatingly revelling in sensual pleasures.

301.sa: यदर्थमयमारम्भः कृतः परपुरञ्जयः। समयं नाभिजानाति कृतार्थः प्लवगेश्वरः4.30.77।।
301.e: 'O conqueror of the enemy capital the monkey lord who has achieved his goal does not realise the importance of my mission.

301.sa: वर्षासमयकालं तु प्रतिज्ञाय हरीश्वरः। व्यतीतांश्चतुरो मासान्विहरन्नावबुध्यते4.30.78।।
301.e: 'Having promised (to search for Sita) after the rainy season,Sugriva is not aware that he has (already) spent the four monthsrevelling.

301.sa: सामात्यपरिषत्क्रीडन्पानमेवोपसेवते। शोकदीनेषु नास्मासु सुग्रीवः कुरुते दयाम्4.30.79।।
301.e: 'Sporting with the council of ministers surrounding him, resorting to drinking, he shows no compassion to us feeling wretched with grief.

301.sa: उच्यतां गच्छ सुग्रीवस्त्वया वत्स महाबल। मम रोषस्य यद्रूपं ब्रूयाश्चैवमिदं वचः4.30.80।।
301.e: 'O mighty warrior O dear, go to Sugriva and make him aware of the virulence of my anger and tell him:

301.sa: न च सङ्कुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः। समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालिपथमन्वगाः4.30.81।।
301.e: 'The route by which Vali departed, killed by me has not been closed. O Sugriva you ought to abide by the pledge given. Do not  follow the path of Vali.

301.sa: एक एव रणे वाली शरेण निहतो मया। त्वां तु सत्यादतिक्रान्तं हनिष्यामि सबान्धवम्4.30.82।।
301.e: 'Vali was killed by me in the battle with a single arrow while I shall kill you now along with your near and dear ones since you have deviated from the truth.'

301.sa: तदेवं विहिते कार्ये यद्धितं पुरुषर्षभ। तत्तद्भ्रूहि नरश्रेष्ठत्वर कालव्यतिक्रमः4.30.83।।
301.e: 'O bull among men O hero speak to him that  all that is done in time is done well. Hurry up. Ask him to do whatever is good for him as well as for us:

301.sa: कुरुष्व सत्यं मयि वानरेश्वर प्रतिश्रुतं धर्ममवेक्ष्य शाश्वतम्। मा वालिनं प्रेत्य गतो यमक्षयं त्वमद्य पश्येर्मम चोदितैश्शरैः4.30.84।।
301.e: 'O lord of monkeys Carry out the promise you made to me, consider it to be eternal dharma. Slain by my arrows, you will see  Vali in the abode of the lord of death.'

301.sa: स पूर्वजं तीव्रविवृद्धकोपं लालप्यमानं प्रसमीक्ष्य दीनम्। चकार तीव्रां मतिमुग्रतेजा हरीश्वरे मानववंशनाथः4.30.85।।
301.e: On seeing Rama, the protector of the human race, wailing Lakshmana of terrific lustre  hardened his stand against Sugriva and proceeded, charged with intense anger. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे त्रिंशस्सर्गः Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

302.sa: स कामिनं दीनमदीनसत्त्वं शोकाभिपन्नं समुदीर्णकोपम्। नरेन्द्रसूनुर्नरदेवपुत्रं रामानुजः पूर्वजमित्युवाच4.31.1।।
302.e: Seeing the indomitable hero, his elder brother, son of a king, lovesick, dejected and overcome by anger and grief, spoke prince Lakshmana:

302.sa: न वानरः स्थास्यति साधुवृत्ते न मंस्यते कर्मफलानुषङ्गान्। न भोज्यते वानरराज्यलक्ष्मीं तथाहि नाभिक्रमतेऽस्य बुद्धिः4.31.2।।
302.e: 'Sugriva has not stuck to the conduct of the virtuous, of sharing the fruits of action equally. He does not realize that he obtained the prosperous kingship of vanaras as a result of your (friendly) action. He does not have the intelligence of conducting himself in your favour (of searching Sita). Therefore he will not enjoy the kingship for long.

302.sa: मतिक्षयाद्ग्राम्यसुखेषु सक्त स्तव प्रसादाप्रतिकारबुद्धिः। हतोऽग्रजं पश्यतु वीर तस्य न राज्यमेवं विगुणस्य देयम्4.31.3।।
302.e: 'O hero he is too ungrateful to return the favour done to him, Engaged in rustic, vulgar pleasures, he is not thinking of it. Let him see his killed elder brother. Kingship should not be given to an individual who is a destitute of virtues.

302.sa: न धारये कोपमुदीर्णवेगं निहन्मि सुग्रीवमसत्यमद्य। हरिप्रवीरैस्सह वालिपुत्रो नरेन्द्रपत्न्या विचयं करोतु4.31.4।।
302.e: 'I cannot hold my overflowing anger. I shall kill this untruthful Sugriva. Let Vali's son along with the foremost of monkeys search for the queen (Sita).'

302.sa: तमात्तबाणासनमुत्पतन्तं निवेदितार्थं रणचण्डकोपम्। उवाच रामः परवीरहन्ता स्ववेक्षितं सानुनयं च वाक्यम्4.31.5।।
302.e: Rama, a slayer of enemy heroes but not of those who seek his refuge, spoke in a conciliatory tone to Lakshmana who jumped, wielding bow and arrows, inspired with his fierce fighting spirit.

302.sa: न हि वै त्वद्विधो लोके पापमेवं समाचरेत्। पापमार्येण यो हन्ति स वीरः पुरुषोत्तमः4.31.6।।
नेदमत्र त्वया ग्राह्यं साधुवृत्तेन लक्ष्मण। तां प्रीतिमनुवर्तस्व पूर्ववृत्तं च सङ्गतम्4.31.7।।
302.e: 'O Lakshmana with your good conduct you should not do so.  Keeping in view the affectionate friendship extended (by Sugriva) earlier, be friendly.

302.sa: सामोपहितया वाचा रूक्षाणि परिवर्जयन्। वक्तुमर्हसि सुग्रीवं व्यतीतं कालपर्यये4.31.8।।
302.e: 'Sugriva has exceeded the time limit. Avoiding harsh words, you ought to speak to him in a conciliatory manner.

302.sa: सोऽग्रजेनानुशिष्टार्थो यथावत्पुरुषर्षभः। प्रविवेश पुरीं वीरो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा4.31.9।।
302.e: Having been duly briefed by his elder brother, the heroic Lakshmana, destroyer of enemies, a bull among men entered the city.

302.sa: ततश्शुभमतिः प्राज्ञो भ्रातुः प्रियहिते रतः। लक्ष्मणः प्रतिसंरब्धो जगाम भवनं कपेः4.31.10।। शक्रबाणासनप्रख्यं धनुः कालान्तकोपमः। प्रगृह्य गिरिशृङ्गाभं मन्दरः सानुमानिव।।4.31.11।।
302.e: The noblehearted, benevolent and wise Lakshmana, eager to please Rama, picked up his bow looking like a mountain peak, comparable to the bow of Indra and agitated with the anger of the god of Death entered the mansion of Sugriva which stood like the mountain peak of Mandara.

302.sa: ततश्शुभमतिः प्राज्ञो भ्रातुः प्रियहिते रतः। लक्ष्मणः प्रतिसंरब्धो जगाम भवनं कपेः4.31.10।। शक्रबाणासनप्रख्यं धनुः कालान्तकोपमः। प्रगृह्य गिरिशृङ्गाभं मन्दरः सानुमानिव।।4.31.11।।
302.e: The noblehearted, benevolent and wise Lakshmana, eager to please Rama, picked up his bow looking like a mountain peak, comparable to the bow of Indra and agitated with the anger of the god of Death entered the mansion of Sugriva which stood like the mountain peak of Mandara.

302.sa: यथोक्तकारी वचनमुत्तरं चैव सोत्तरम्। बृहस्पतिसमो बुद्ध्या मत्वा रामानुजस्तदा4.31.12।। कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन भ्रातुः कोपाग्निना वृतः। प्रभञ्जन इवाप्रीतः प्रययौ लक्ष्मणस्तदा4.31.13।।
302.e: Then Lakshmana, obedient, intelligent like Brihaspati, like a tempest, encompassed by the fire of anger and deliberating in his mind as to the possible questions from Sugriva and the reply from him.

302.sa: यथोक्तकारी वचनमुत्तरं चैव सोत्तरम्। बृहस्पतिसमो बुद्ध्या मत्वा रामानुजस्तदा4.31.12।। कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन भ्रातुः कोपाग्निना वृतः। प्रभञ्जन इवाप्रीतः प्रययौ लक्ष्मणस्तदा4.31.13।।
302.e: Then Lakshmana, obedient, intelligent like Brihaspati, like a tempest, encompassed by the fire of anger and deliberating in his mind as to the possible questions from Sugriva and the reply from him.

302.sa: सालतालाश्वकर्णांश्च तरसा पातयन्बहून्। पर्यस्यन्गिरिकूटानि द्रुमानन्यांश्च वेगतः4.31.14।। शिलाश्च शकलीकुर्वन्पद्भ्यां गज इवाशुगः। दूरामेकपदं त्यक्त्वा ययौ कार्यवशाद्द्रुतम्4.31.15।।
302.e: 'Lakshmana rushed on foot speedily, cutting the branches of sala, tala and asvakarna and other trees on the way  and forcibly turning and crushing the mountain rocks into pieces with a single foot, like a swiftmoving elephant taking long strides, to carry out the task.

302.sa: सालतालाश्वकर्णांश्च तरसा पातयन्बहून्। पर्यस्यन्गिरिकूटानि द्रुमानन्यांश्च वेगतः4.31.14।। शिलाश्च शकलीकुर्वन्पद्भ्यां गज इवाशुगः। दूरामेकपदं त्यक्त्वा ययौ कार्यवशाद्द्रुतम्4.31.15।।
302.e: 'Lakshmana rushed on foot speedily, cutting the branches of sala, tala and asvakarna and other trees on the way  and forcibly turning and crushing the mountain rocks into pieces with a single foot, like a swiftmoving elephant taking long strides, to carry out the task.

302.sa: तामपश्यद्बलाकीर्णां हरिराजमहापुरीम्। दुर्गामिक्ष्वाकुशार्दूलः किष्किन्धां गिरिसङ्गटे4.31.16।।
302.e: The tiger of the Ikshvaku race saw the inaccessible Kishkinda, the capital of vanara kingdom, located between mountains and fortified with the army.

302.sa: रोषात्प्रस्फुरमाणोष्ठ स्सुग्रीवं प्रति लक्ष्मणः। ददर्श वानरान्भीमाकनिष्किन्धाया बहिश्चरान्4.31.17।।
302.e: His lips trembling in anger, Lakshmana saw fierceful monkey guards of Sugriva at the entrance of Kishkinda city.

302.sa: तं दृष्ट्वा वानरास्सर्वे लक्ष्मणं पुरुषर्षभम्। शैलशृङ्गाणि शतशः प्रवृद्धांश्च महीरुहान्4.31.18।। जगृहुः कुञ्जरप्रख्या वानराः पर्वतान्तरे।
302.e: Hundreds of monkeys of the size of elephants stood holding huge trees and boulders of rocks on seeing Lakshmana, the bull among men.

302.sa: तान्गृहीतप्रहरणान्सर्वान्दृष्ट्वा तु लक्ष्मणः4.31.19।। बभूव द्विगुणं क्रुद्धो बह्विन्धन इवानलः।
302.e: On seeing the monkeys wielding weapons, Lakshmana's anger doubled like logs of firewood put to burning.

302.sa: तं ते भयपरीताङ्गाः क्रुद्धं दृष्ट्वा प्लवङ्गमाः4.31.20।। कालमृत्युयुगान्ताभं शतशो विद्रुता दिशः।
302.e: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, who looked like a veritable god of Death at the time of dissolution of the universe, hundreds of monkeys, their limbs trembling in fear ran in different directions.

302.sa: ततस्सुग्रीवभवनं प्रविश्य हरिपुङ्गवाः4.31.21।। क्रोधमागमनं चैव लक्ष्मणस्य न्यवेदयन्।
302.e: Having entered Sugriva's palace, the monkeychiefs reported the arrival of angry Lakshmana.

302.sa: तारया सहितः कामी सक्तः कपिवृषो रहः4.31.22।। न तेषां कपिवीराणां शुश्राव वचनं तदा।
302.e: But Sugriva who was engrossed in overtures with passionate Tara, did not heed the words of the monkeychiefs.

302.sa: ततस्सचिवसन्दिष्टा हरयो रोमहर्षणाः। गिरिकुञ्जर मेघाभा नगर्या निर्ययुस्तदा।।4.31.23।।
302.e: Commanded by the ministers, the monkeys who looked like fierce mountains, elephants and clouds that caused horripilation, left the place at once.

302.sa: नखदंष्ट्रायुधा घोरास्सर्वे विकृतदर्शनाः4.31.24।। सर्वे शार्दूलदर्पाश्च सर्वे च विकृताननाः।
302.e: The monkeys, their faces, deformed, their nails and teeth like weapons were dreadful and horrifying in appearance, proud as tigers

302.sa: दशनागबलाः केचित्केचिद्दशगुणोत्तराः4.31.25।। केचिन्नागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः।
302.e: Of them some possessed the strength of ten, some a hundred and some a thousand elephants. All of them were of equal valour.

302.sa: कृत्स्नांहि कपिभिर्व्याप्तां द्रुमहस्सैर्महाबलैः4.31.26।। अपश्यल्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धः किष्किन्धां तां दुरासदाम्।
302.e: Enraged Lakshmana saw the huge inacccessible city of Kishkinda filled with  mighty strong and fierce monkeys holding trees in hand.

302.sa: ततस्ते हरयस्सर्वे प्राकारपरिघान्तरात्4.31.27।। निष्क्रम्योदग्रसत्त्वास्तु तस्थुराविष्कृतं तदा।
302.e: The mighty monkeys came out of the entrance of the ironboundary wall from beneath and made their appearance and stood in full attention.

302.sa: सुग्रीवस्य प्रमादं च पूर्वजं चार्तमात्मवान्4.31.28।। बुद्ध्वा कोपवशं वीरः पुनरेव जगाम सः।
302.e: The sensible warrior, recognising Sugriva's dereliction of duty and his own brother's agony once again flew into fury.

302.sa: स दीर्घोष्णमहोच्छवासः कोपसंरक्तलोचनः4.31.29।। बभूव नरशार्दूल स्सधूम इव पावकः।
302.e: Sighing hot, deep breath, eyes turned red in anger, this tiger among men appeared like fire with smoke (The sigh was smoke and red eyes, fire).

302.sa: बाणशल्यस्फुरज्जिह्वस्सायकासनभोगवान्4.31.30।। स्वतेजोविषसङ्घातः पञ्चास्य इव पन्नगः।
302.e: His bow was like the hood of a snake,with the iron nails fixed on the tip of his arrows like moving fangs and his own brightness like the venom of the fivehooded snake.

302.sa: तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं नागेन्द्रमिव कोपितम्4.31.31।। समासाद्याङ्गदस्त्रासाद्विषादमगमद्भृशम्।
302.e: Dismayed, Angada approached Lakshmana, who was glowing like fire at the time of dissolution of the world and enraged like the lord of serpents.

302.sa: सोऽङ्गदं रोषताम्राक्षस्सन्दिदेश महायशाः4.31.32।। सुग्रीवः कथ्यतां वत्स ममागमनमित्युत।
302.e: Renowned Lakshmana, with his eyes turned red in anger said to Angada 'O dear, inform Sugriva, about my arrival'.

302.sa: एष रामानुजः प्राप्तस्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम4.31.33।। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तो द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः। तस्य वाक्यं यदि रुचिः क्रियतां साधु वानर4.31.34।। इत्युक्त्वा शीघ्रमागच्छ वत्स वाक्यमरिन्दम।
302.e: 'O subduer of enemies speak in this way: 'Lakshmana, the dear younger brother of Rama has come to you and waits for your presence at the entrance, burning in grief of his elder brother. Well, if you like to hear his words, do as you please.' 'Return swiftly after saying so.'

302.sa: एष रामानुजः प्राप्तस्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम4.31.33।। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तो द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः। तस्य वाक्यं यदि रुचिः क्रियतां साधु वानर4.31.34।। इत्युक्त्वा शीघ्रमागच्छ वत्स वाक्यमरिन्दम।
302.e: 'O subduer of enemies speak in this way: 'Lakshmana, the dear younger brother of Rama has come to you and waits for your presence at the entrance, burning in grief of his elder brother. Well, if you like to hear his words, do as you please.' 'Return swiftly after saying so.'

302.sa: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शोकाविष्टोऽङ्गदोऽब्रवीत्। पितुस्समीपमागम्य सौमित्रिरयमागतः4.31.35।।
302.e: On hearing Lakshmana's words Angada became sad. He approached his father (Sugriva) and said 'Saumitri has come'. (This sloka appears an interpolation).

302.sa: अथाङ्गदस्तस्य वचो निशम्य सम्भ्रान्तभावः परिदीनवक्त्रः। निपत्य तूर्णं नृपतेस्तरस्वी ततः रुमायाश्चरणौ ववन्दे4.31.36।।
302.e: On hearing Lakshmana's words powerful Angada felt agitated. His face turned pale. He went and prostrated at once to the king and then to the queen, Ruma.

302.sa: संङ्गृह्य पादौ पितुरग्र्यतेजाः जग्राह मातुः पुनरेव पादौ। पादौ रुमायाश्च निपीडयित्वा निवेदयामास ततस्तमर्थम्4.31.37।।
302.e: Highly brilliant Angada holding his father's feet first, then mother's and thereafter Ruma's, reported the matter to  Sugriva.

302.sa: स निद्रामदसंवीतो वानरो न विबुद्धवान्। बभूव मदमत्तश्च मदनेन च मोहितः4.31.38।।
302.e: The monkey was too drowsy with drink, too intoxicated with passion to come back to his senses.

302.sa: ततः किलकिलां चक्रुर्लक्ष्मणं प्रेक्ष्य वानराः। प्रसादयन्तस्तं क्रुद्धं भयमोहितचेतसः4.31.39।।
302.e: Looking at angry Lakshmana, and scared at heart, the monkeys started making a noise in order to please him.

302.sa: ते महौघनिभं दृष्ट्वा वज्राशनिसमस्वनम्। सिंहनादं समं चक्रुर्लक्ष्मणस्य समीपतः4.31.40।।
302.e: They saw Lakshmana advancing like a mighty flood and went near him making sounds like the thunderbolt or a lion.

302.sa: तेन शब्देन महता प्रत्यबुध्यत वानरः। मदविह्वलताम्राक्षो व्याकुलस्रग्विभूषणः4.31.41।।
302.e: By the great sound (of the monkeys) the drunken redeyed vanara king awakened, his garlands and ornaments in disarray.

302.sa: अथाङ्गदवचः श्रुत्वा तेनैव च समागतौ। मन्त्रिणौ वानरेन्द्रस्य सम्मतौ दारदर्शिनौ4.31.42।। प्लक्षश्चैव प्रभावश्च मन्त्रिणावर्थधर्मयोः। वक्तुमुच्चावचं प्राप्तं लक्ष्मणं तौ शशंसतुः4.31.43।।
302.e: On hearing Angada's words the two ministers named Plaksha and Prabhava who were perrmitted to have audience with the queens went to the harem on invitation from Angada. They reported to Sugriva about the arrival of Lakshmana who had come to speak to him about matters regading wealth and righteousness.

302.sa: अथाङ्गदवचः श्रुत्वा तेनैव च समागतौ। मन्त्रिणौ वानरेन्द्रस्य सम्मतौ दारदर्शिनौ4.31.42।। प्लक्षश्चैव प्रभावश्च मन्त्रिणावर्थधर्मयोः। वक्तुमुच्चावचं प्राप्तं लक्ष्मणं तौ शशंसतुः4.31.43।।
302.e: On hearing Angada's words the two ministers named Plaksha and Prabhava who were perrmitted to have audience with the queens went to the harem on invitation from Angada. They reported to Sugriva about the arrival of Lakshmana who had come to speak to him about matters regading wealth and righteousness.

302.sa: प्रसादयित्वा सुग्रीवं वचनैस्सामनिश्चितैः। आसीनं पर्युपासीनौ यथा शक्रं मरुत्पतिम्4.31.44।।
302.e: Both of them sat close by Sugriva who was like Indra and said these pleasing words:

302.sa: सत्यसन्धौ महाभागौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। वयस्यभावं सम्प्राप्तौ राज्यार्हौ राज्यदायिनौ4.31.45।।
302.e: 'Rama and Lakshmana, both the brothers venerable and true to their promise, have conferred on you sovereignty and have extended friendship.'

302.sa: तयोरेको धनुष्पाणिर्द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः। यस्य भीताः प्रवेपन्तो नादान्मुञ्चन्ति वानराः4.31.46।।
302.e: 'Of the two, only Lakshmana is standing at the entrance wielding his bow in hand. The monkeys are trembling in fear and running about, making a loud noise'.

302.sa: स एष राघवभ्राता लक्ष्मणो वाक्यसारथिः। व्यवसायरथः प्राप्तस्तस्य रामस्य शासनात्4.31.47।।
302.e: 'By the command of Rama, his brother has come to you, Rama's words as charioteer and his work as chariot'.

302.sa: अयं च दयितो राजंस्ताराया स्तनयोऽङ्गदः। लक्ष्मणेन सकाशं ते प्रेषितस्त्वरयाऽनघ4.31.48।।
302.e: 'O blameless king Tara's son, Angada, has sent us into your presence. Lakshmana has come.'

302.sa: सोऽयं रोषपरीताक्षो द्वारि तिष्ठति वीर्यवान्। वानरान्वानरपते चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव4.31.49।।
302.e: 'O lord of monkeys Valiant Lakshmana is standing at the entrance,eyes filled with anger as if he would burn the vanaras'.

302.sa: तस्य मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य त्वं सपुत्रस्सहबन्धुभिः। गच्छ शीघ्रं महाराज रोषो ह्यस्य निवर्त्यताम्4.31.50।।
302.e: 'O great king Go at once with your son and relations, salute him now and avert his anger'.

302.sa: यदाह रामो धर्मात्मा तत्कुरुष्व समाहितः। राजं स्तिष्ठस्व समये भव सत्यप्रतिश्रवाः4.31.51।।
302.e: 'O king be true to your promise to his brother, righteous Rama without fail. Honour the agreement.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

303.sa: अङ्गदस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्सचिवैस्सह। लक्ष्मणं कुपितं श्रुत्वा मुमोचासनमात्मवान्4.32.1।।
303.e: On hearing about Lakshmana's anger from Angada, prudent Sugriva consulted his counsellors.

303.sa: सचिवानब्रवीद्वाक्यं निश्चित्य गुरुलाघवम्। मन्त्रज्ञान्मन्त्रकुशलो मन्त्रेषु परिनिष्ठितान्4.32.2।।
303.e: Sugriva, being skilled in secret assessment of matters, considering the merits and demerits, spoke to his council of ministers capable of intelligent counselling:

303.sa: न मे दुर्व्याहृतं किञ्चिन्नापि मे दुरनुष्ठितम्। लक्ष्मणो राघवभ्राता क्रुद्धः किमिति चिन्तये4.32.3।।
303.e: 'Indeed I have not uttered any harsh word or done anything wrong. I, therefore, wonder why Rama's brother, Lakshmana is angry with me?

303.sa: असुहृद्भिर्ममामित्रैर्नित्यमन्तरदर्शिभिः। मम दोषानसम्भूतान् श्रावितो राघवानुजः4.32.4।।
303.e: 'Some enemies, who are always searching for imaginary faults of mine might have poisoned Lakshmana's ears.

303.sa: अत्र तावद्यथाबुद्धि सर्वैरेव यथाविधि। भावस्य निश्चयस्तावद्विज्ञेयो निपुणं शनैः4.32.5।।
303.e: 'In the meanwhile, (right now) all of you should think quietly and try to know the reason (for Lakshmana's anger), using your intellect and expertise logically and decide( the course of action).

303.sa: न खल्वस्ति मम त्रासो लक्ष्मणान्नापि राघवात्। मित्रं त्वस्थानकुपितं जनयत्येव सम्भ्रमम्4.32.6।।
303.e: 'I have no fear either from Lakshmana or from Rama. However, when a friend is enraged without reason, it creates misgivings.

303.sa: सर्वथा सुकरं मित्रं दुष्करं परिपालनम्। अनित्यत्वाच्छ चित्तानां प्रीतिरल्पेपि भिद्यते4.32.7।।
303.e: 'It is easy to earn a friend but keeping the friendship sustained is difficult. Due to fickleness of mind friendship gets broken even on flimsy grounds.

303.sa: अतो निमित्तं त्रस्तोहं रामेण तु महात्मना। यन्मयोपकृतं शक्यं प्रतिकर्तुं न तन्मया4.32.8।।
303.e: 'Therefore, I am apprehensive of Rama. I am not able to repay the help he has rendered to me'.

303.sa: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान्हरिपुङ्गवः। उवाच स्वेन तर्केण मध्ये वानरमन्त्रिणाम्4.32.9।।
303.e: When Sugriva spoke thus, Hanuman the great monkey, submitted in the presnce of the monkeyministers, applying his own logic:

303.sa: सर्वथा नैतदाश्चर्यं यस्त्वं हरिगणेश्वर। न विस्मरसि सुस्निग्धमुपकार कृतं शुभम्4.32.10।।
303.e: 'It is not at all a matter of surprise, O king of vanara clan, that you forgot the good service rendered to you with utmost sense of friendship.

303.sa: राघवेण तु वीरेण भयमुत्सृज्य दूरतः। त्वत्प्रियार्थं हतो वाली शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः4.32.11।।
303.e: 'To remove your fear and to please you, the great hero Rama has killed Vali, an equal to Indra in valour.

303.sa: सर्वथा प्रणयात्कृद्धो राघवो नात्र संशयः। भ्रातरं सम्प्रहितवान्लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्4.32.12।।
303.e: 'Rama's anger is purely out of love for you. He has sent Lakshmana, a bestower of prosperity to you. There is no doubt about it.

303.sa: त्वं प्रमत्तो न जानीषे कालं कालविदां वर। फुल्लसप्तच्छदश्यामा प्रवृत्ता तु शरच्छिवा4.32.13।।
303.e: 'You knows best the passage of time (changing seasons). But you are not aware out of inattention that the auspicious autumn has set in, making the garden lush green with blossoms of Saptachada flowers.

303.sa: निर्मलग्रहनक्षत्रा द्यौः प्रनष्टवलाहका। प्रसन्नाश्च दिशस्सर्वास्सरितश्च सरांसि च4.32.14।।
303.e: 'The sky from which the dark clouds have completely disappeared is illumined with planets and stars. The rivers and tanks as well as all directions are pleasant.

303.sa: प्राप्तमुद्योगकालं तु नावैषि हरिपुङ्गव। त्वं प्रमत्त इति व्यक्तं लक्ष्मणोऽयमिहागतः4.32.15।।
303.e: 'O chief of monkeys it is time for military expeditions. Since you are intoxicated you are not aware of this, Lakshmana has come here evidently for this.

303.sa: आर्तस्य हृतदारस्य पुरुषं पुरुषान्तरात्। वचनं मर्षणीयं ते राघवस्य महात्मनः4.32.16।।
303.e: 'The message sent by a man who is in distress, and is deprived of his wife should be accepted even if they are harsh since he is a great self (who has rendered you help).

303.sa: कृतापराधस्य हि ते नान्यत्पश्याम्यहं क्षमम्। अन्तरेणाञ्जलिं बद्ध्वा लक्ष्मणस्य प्रसादनात्4.32.17।।
303.e: 'In these circumstances the best way is seeking apology from Lakshmana with folded hands. I do not see any way other than this.

303.sa: नियुक्तैर्मन्त्रिभिर्वाच्यो ह्यवश्यं पार्थिवो हितम्। अत एव भयं त्यक्त्वा ब्रवीम्यवधृतं वचः4.32.18।।
303.e: 'The counsellors and ministers appointed by a king should certainly give good advice, without fear. This I tell you since I have faith in my words.

303.sa: अभिक्रुद्धस्समर्थो हि चापमुद्यम्य राघवः। सदेवासुरगन्धर्वं वशे स्थापयितुं जगत्4.32.19।।
न स क्षमः कोपयितुं यः प्रसाद्यः पुनर्भवेत्। पूर्वोपकारं स्मरता कृतज्ञेन विशेषतः4.32.20।।
303.e: 'He who deserves propitiation, should not be offended, more so by a  grateful man, remembering the  help received by him earlier.

303.sa: तस्य मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य त्वं सपुत्रस्ससुहृज्जनः। राजंस्तिष्ठस्व समये भर्तुर्भार्येव तद्वशः4.32.21।।
303.e: 'O king bow down your head along with your son, friends and relations and honour the oath just as a wife subordinates to the will of the husband. Stand by obediently.

303.sa: न रामरामानुजशासनं त्वया कपीन्द्र युक्तं मनसाऽप्यपोहितुम्। मनो हि ते ज्ञास्यति मानुषं बलं स राघवस्यास्य सुरेन्द्रवर्चसः4.32.22।।
303.e: 'O king of monkeys It is not right for you to overlook the commands of Rama or Lakshmana even in mind. You know the superhuman virtues of Rama, particularly his valour. The two brothers are like Indra (and Upendra) in valour and might. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysecond sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

304.sa: अथ प्रतिसमादिष्टो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। प्रविवेश गुहां घोरां किष्किन्धां रामशासनात्।।4.33.1।।
304.e: Instructed by Rama, and having been permitted, Lakshmana, the slayer of enemies entered the frightful cave of Kishkinda.

304.sa: द्वारस्था हरयस्तत्र महाकाया महाबलाः। बभूवुर्लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे प्राञ्जलय स्थिताः।।4.33.2।।
304.e: Seeing Lakshmana, the huge and mighty monkey gatekeepers stood at the entrance and greeted him with folded hands.

304.sa: निश्वसन्तं तु तं दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धं दशरथात्मजम्। बभूवुर्हरयस्त्रस्ता न चैनं पर्यवारयन्।।4.33.3।।
304.e: The monkeys kept away out of fear to see the son of Dasaratha, who was angry and sighing deeply.

304.sa: स तां रत्नमयीं श्रीमान्दिव्यां पुष्पितकाननाम्। रम्यां रत्नसमाकीर्णां ददर्श महतीं गुहाम्।।4.33.4।।
304.e: Lakshmana, the bestower of fortune, saw the mammoth cave inlaid with gems and precious stones and forests full of delightful flowers.

304.sa: हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधां नानापण्योपशोभिताम्। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभिताम्।।4.33.5।।
304.e: The palace was thronged with elevated mansions and illumined with jewels of all kinds. The trees were in bloom and the fruits satisfied every one's wish.It was splendid.

304.sa: देवगन्धर्वपुत्रैश्च वानरैः कामरूपिभिः। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरै श्शोभितां प्रियदर्शनैः।।4.33.6।।
304.e: The inhabitants of Kishkinda being sons of gods and gandharvas, were of beautiful appearance wearing wonderful garlands. They could change their form at their free will. They were delightful.

304.sa: चन्दनागरुपद्मानां गन्धैस्सुरभिगन्धिनाम्। मैरेयाणां मधूनां च सम्मोदितमहापथाम्।।4.33.7।।
304.e: The royal roads were filled with fragrant unguents, like sandal, agaru and lotus incenses, finesmelling honey of several kinds and happy inhabitants.

304.sa: विन्ध्यमेरुगिरिप्रख्यै: प्रासादैर्नैकभूमिभिः। ददर्श गिरिनद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र राघवः।।4.33.8।।
304.e: Lakshmana saw tall buildings comparable to Vindhya and Meru mountains and pure water flowing from the mountain streams.

304.sa: अङ्गदस्य गृहं रम्यं मैन्दस्य द्विविधस्य च। गवयस्य गवाक्षस्य गजस्य शरभस्य च।।4.33.9।। विद्युन्मालेश्च सम्पाते स्सूर्याक्षस्य हनूमतः। वीरबाहो स्सुबाहोश्च नलस्य च महात्मनः।।4.33.10।। कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तारजाम्बवतोस्तथा। दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः।।4.33.11।। एतेषां कपिमुख्यानां राजमार्गे महात्मनाम्। ददर्श गृहमुख्यानि महासाराणि लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.12।।
304.e: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)

304.sa: अङ्गदस्य गृहं रम्यं मैन्दस्य द्विविधस्य च। गवयस्य गवाक्षस्य गजस्य शरभस्य च।।4.33.9।। विद्युन्मालेश्च सम्पाते स्सूर्याक्षस्य हनूमतः। वीरबाहो स्सुबाहोश्च नलस्य च महात्मनः।।4.33.10।। कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तारजाम्बवतोस्तथा। दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः।।4.33.11।। एतेषां कपिमुख्यानां राजमार्गे महात्मनाम्। ददर्श गृहमुख्यानि महासाराणि लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.12।।
304.e: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)

304.sa: अङ्गदस्य गृहं रम्यं मैन्दस्य द्विविधस्य च। गवयस्य गवाक्षस्य गजस्य शरभस्य च।।4.33.9।। विद्युन्मालेश्च सम्पाते स्सूर्याक्षस्य हनूमतः। वीरबाहो स्सुबाहोश्च नलस्य च महात्मनः।।4.33.10।। कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तारजाम्बवतोस्तथा। दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः।।4.33.11।। एतेषां कपिमुख्यानां राजमार्गे महात्मनाम्। ददर्श गृहमुख्यानि महासाराणि लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.12।।
304.e: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)

304.sa: अङ्गदस्य गृहं रम्यं मैन्दस्य द्विविधस्य च। गवयस्य गवाक्षस्य गजस्य शरभस्य च।।4.33.9।। विद्युन्मालेश्च सम्पाते स्सूर्याक्षस्य हनूमतः। वीरबाहो स्सुबाहोश्च नलस्य च महात्मनः।।4.33.10।। कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तारजाम्बवतोस्तथा। दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः।।4.33.11।। एतेषां कपिमुख्यानां राजमार्गे महात्मनाम्। ददर्श गृहमुख्यानि महासाराणि लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.12।।
304.e: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)

304.sa: पाण्डुराभ्रप्रकाशानि दिव्यमाल्ययुतानि च। प्रभूतधनधान्यानि स्त्रीरत्नै श्शोभितानि च।।4.33.13।।
304.e: These homes were shining like white clouds, with wonderful garlands hung on, filled with abundance of wealth, grains and best of females.

304.sa: पाण्डुरेण तु सालेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।4.33.14।। शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्।।4.33.15।। महेन्द्रदत्तैश्श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसन्निभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैशीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः।।4.33.16।। हरिभिस्संवृतद्वारं बलिभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्।।4.33.17।। सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणस्सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः।।4.33.18।।
304.e: The abode of Sugriva was encircled by a white rampart and unapproachable.It was enchanting like the abode of Indra. The mansion tops were like the white peaks of Kailas mountain filled with blossoming trees which could yield all kinds of fruits to suit one's taste. The trees were huge like dark clouds, cool and shady with wonderful flowers in full bloom, the riches gifted by Indra, were delightful. The entrance was guarded by mighty monkeys holding weapons in hand. It had a golden archway at the entrance decorated with wonderful garlands and strings of golden flowers. Saumitri of great prowess entered the rich abode of Sugriva just as the Sun enters huge clouds unobstructed.

304.sa: पाण्डुरेण तु सालेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।4.33.14।। शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्।।4.33.15।। महेन्द्रदत्तैश्श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसन्निभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैशीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः।।4.33.16।। हरिभिस्संवृतद्वारं बलिभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्।।4.33.17।। सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणस्सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः।।4.33.18।।
304.e: The abode of Sugriva was encircled by a white rampart and unapproachable.It was enchanting like the abode of Indra. The mansion tops were like the white peaks of Kailas mountain filled with blossoming trees which could yield all kinds of fruits to suit one's taste. The trees were huge like dark clouds, cool and shady with wonderful flowers in full bloom, the riches gifted by Indra, were delightful. The entrance was guarded by mighty monkeys holding weapons in hand. It had a golden archway at the entrance decorated with wonderful garlands and strings of golden flowers. Saumitri of great prowess entered the rich abode of Sugriva just as the Sun enters huge clouds unobstructed.

304.sa: पाण्डुरेण तु सालेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।4.33.14।। शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्।।4.33.15।। महेन्द्रदत्तैश्श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसन्निभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैशीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः।।4.33.16।। हरिभिस्संवृतद्वारं बलिभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्।।4.33.17।। सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणस्सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः।।4.33.18।।
304.e: The abode of Sugriva was encircled by a white rampart and unapproachable.It was enchanting like the abode of Indra. The mansion tops were like the white peaks of Kailas mountain filled with blossoming trees which could yield all kinds of fruits to suit one's taste. The trees were huge like dark clouds, cool and shady with wonderful flowers in full bloom, the riches gifted by Indra, were delightful. The entrance was guarded by mighty monkeys holding weapons in hand. It had a golden archway at the entrance decorated with wonderful garlands and strings of golden flowers. Saumitri of great prowess entered the rich abode of Sugriva just as the Sun enters huge clouds unobstructed.

304.sa: पाण्डुरेण तु सालेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।4.33.14।। शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्।।4.33.15।। महेन्द्रदत्तैश्श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसन्निभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैशीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः।।4.33.16।। हरिभिस्संवृतद्वारं बलिभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्।।4.33.17।। सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणस्सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः।।4.33.18।।
304.e: The abode of Sugriva was encircled by a white rampart and unapproachable.It was enchanting like the abode of Indra. The mansion tops were like the white peaks of Kailas mountain filled with blossoming trees which could yield all kinds of fruits to suit one's taste. The trees were huge like dark clouds, cool and shady with wonderful flowers in full bloom, the riches gifted by Indra, were delightful. The entrance was guarded by mighty monkeys holding weapons in hand. It had a golden archway at the entrance decorated with wonderful garlands and strings of golden flowers. Saumitri of great prowess entered the rich abode of Sugriva just as the Sun enters huge clouds unobstructed.

304.sa: पाण्डुरेण तु सालेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।4.33.14।। शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्।।4.33.15।। महेन्द्रदत्तैश्श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसन्निभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैशीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः।।4.33.16।। हरिभिस्संवृतद्वारं बलिभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्।।4.33.17।। सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणस्सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः।।4.33.18।।
304.e: The abode of Sugriva was encircled by a white rampart and unapproachable.It was enchanting like the abode of Indra. The mansion tops were like the white peaks of Kailas mountain filled with blossoming trees which could yield all kinds of fruits to suit one's taste. The trees were huge like dark clouds, cool and shady with wonderful flowers in full bloom, the riches gifted by Indra, were delightful. The entrance was guarded by mighty monkeys holding weapons in hand. It had a golden archway at the entrance decorated with wonderful garlands and strings of golden flowers. Saumitri of great prowess entered the rich abode of Sugriva just as the Sun enters huge clouds unobstructed.

304.sa: स सप्त कक्ष्या धर्मात्मा नानाजनसमाकुलाः। प्रविश्य सुमहद्गगुप्तं ददर्शान्तःपुरं महत्।।4.33.19।। हैमराजतपर्यङ्कैर्बहुभिश्च वरासनैः। महार्हास्तरणोपेतैस्तत्र तत्रोपशोभितम्।।4.33.20।।
304.e: Righteous Lakshmana crossed the seven enclosures filled with different kinds of people and saw a great harem full of several bright gold and silver cots, excellent  seats here and there with best of cushions spread.

304.sa: स सप्त कक्ष्या धर्मात्मा नानाजनसमाकुलाः। प्रविश्य सुमहद्गगुप्तं ददर्शान्तःपुरं महत्।।4.33.19।। हैमराजतपर्यङ्कैर्बहुभिश्च वरासनैः। महार्हास्तरणोपेतैस्तत्र तत्रोपशोभितम्।।4.33.20।।
304.e: Righteous Lakshmana crossed the seven enclosures filled with different kinds of people and saw a great harem full of several bright gold and silver cots, excellent  seats here and there with best of cushions spread.

304.sa: प्रविशन्नेव सततं शुश्राव मधुरस्वरम्। तन्त्रीगीतसमाकीर्णं समगीतपदाक्षरम्।।4.33.21।।
304.e: As he entered, he heard melodious sounds of string instruments and music worded to metre with different kinds of tunes.

304.sa: बह्वीश्च विविधाकारा रूपयौवनगर्विताः। स्त्रियस्सुग्रीवभवने ददर्श सुमहाबलः।।4.33.22।।
304.e: Powerful Lakshmana saw many females of different forms proud of their youth and charm at the palace of Sugriva.

304.sa: दृष्ट्वाऽभिजनसम्पन्नाश्चित्रमाल्यकृतस्रजः। फलमाल्यकृतव्यग्रा भूषणोत्तमभूषिताः।।4.33.23।। नातृप्तान्नापि चाव्यग्रान्नानुदात्तपरिच्छदान्। सुग्रीवानुचरांश्चापि लक्षयामास लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.24।।
304.e: Lakshmana saw women with a good lineage adorned with colourful flower garlands and choicest ornaments engaged in making garlands and arranging fruits. He also saw at Sugriva's palace attendants, gentle, welldressed, contented and not too busy.

304.sa: दृष्ट्वाऽभिजनसम्पन्नाश्चित्रमाल्यकृतस्रजः। फलमाल्यकृतव्यग्रा भूषणोत्तमभूषिताः।।4.33.23।। नातृप्तान्नापि चाव्यग्रान्नानुदात्तपरिच्छदान्। सुग्रीवानुचरांश्चापि लक्षयामास लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.24।।
304.e: Lakshmana saw women with a good lineage adorned with colourful flower garlands and choicest ornaments engaged in making garlands and arranging fruits. He also saw at Sugriva's palace attendants, gentle, welldressed, contented and not too busy.

304.sa: कूजितं नूपुराणां च काञ्चीनां निनदं तथा। सन्निशम्य तत श्रीमान्सौमित्रिर्लज्जितोऽभवत्।।4.33.25।।
304.e: Illustrious Lakshmana felt abashed on hearing the jingling of girdle bells and tinkling of the women's anklets.

304.sa: रोषवेगप्रकुपितशश्रुत्वा चाभरणस्वनम्। चकार ज्यास्वनं वीरो दिशश्शब्देन पूरयन्।।4.33.26।।
304.e: On hearing the sounds of ornaments (of females), heroic Lakshmana lost his temper quickly. He pulled his bowstring forcefully in wrath producing frightening sound filling all quarters.

304.sa: चारित्रेण महाबाहुरपकृष्ट स्सलक्ष्मणः। तस्थावेकान्तमाश्रित्य रामकोपसमन्वितः।।4.33.27।।
304.e: Aware of the anger of Rama (who likes it not), the longarmed Lakshmana moved away from the spot (abstained from entering private apartments) as per tradition, receded to a lonely place and stood.

304.sa: तेन चापस्वनेनाथ सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः। विज्ञायाऽगमनं त्रस्त स्सञ्चचाल वरासनात्।।4.33.28।।
304.e: Then, sensing the arrival of Lakshmana, by the sound of his bow string, Sugriva the lord of vanaras, alighted at once from the throne.

304.sa: अङ्गदेन यथा मह्यं पुरस्तात्प्रतिवेदितम्। सुव्यक्तमेष सम्प्राप्त स्सौमित्रिर्भ्रातृवत्सलः।।4.33.29।।
304.e: 'Truly Saumitri, the loving brother of Rama has arrived as announced by Angada earlier'.

304.sa: अङ्गदेन समाख्यातं ज्यास्वनेन च वानरः। बुबुधे लक्ष्मणं प्राप्तं मुखं चास्यव्यशुष्यत।।4.33.30।।
304.e: As proclaimed by Angada and also from the sound of the twang, Sugriva knew about the arrival of Lakshmana. His mouth parched (with fear).

304.sa: ततस्तारां हरिश्रेष्ठस्सुग्रीवः प्रियदर्शनाम्। उवाच हितमव्यग्रस्त्रास सम्भ्रान्तमानसः।।4.33.31।।
304.e: Then Sugriva, the best of monkeys got agitated at heart out of fear. He saw the pleasing Tara and said to her these good words clearly:

304.sa: किन्नु तत्कारणं सुभ्रु प्रकृत्या मृदुमानसः। सरोष इव सम्प्राप्तो येनायं राघवानुजः।।4.33.32।।
304.e: 'O Tara with beautiful eyebrows this younger brother of Rama is normally softhearted. But today he arrived here angry. What could be the reason?

304.sa: किं पश्यसि कुमारस्य रोषस्थानमनिन्दिते। न खल्वकारणे कोपमाहरेन्नरसत्तमः।।4.33.33।।
304.e: 'O blemishless Tara  What is the cause of young Lakshmana's anger? Great men do not display anger without reason.

304.sa: यदस्य कृतमस्माभिर्बुध्यसे किञ्चिदप्रियम्। तदबुद्ध्या सम्प्रधार्याशु क्षिप्रमर्हसि भाषितुम्।।4.33.34।।
304.e: 'If anything displeasing has been done by us, you should know and tell me quickly. You ought to speak to him at once.

304.sa: अथवा स्वयमेवैनं द्रष्टुमर्हसि भामिनि। वचनै स्सान्त्वयुक्तैश्च प्रसादयितुमर्हसि।।4.33.35।।
304.e: 'O lovely lady or else, you should see him personally and propitiate him with your soothing words.

304.sa: त्वद्दर्शन विशुद्धात्मा न स कोपं करिष्यति। न हि स्त्रीषु महात्मानः क्वचित्कुर्वन्ति दारुणम्।।4.33.36।।
304.e: 'Lakshmana will be clear of all doubts on seeing you and will not be angry. Great men are not harsh to women.

304.sa: त्वया सान्त्वैरुपक्रान्तं प्रसन्नेन्द्रियमानसम्। ततः कमलपत्राक्षं द्रक्ष्याम्यहमरिन्दमम्।।4.33.37।।
304.e: 'Start talking to him with pleasing words and make him happy. Then I shall see Lakshmana with eyes like lotuspetals, a subduer of enemies'.

304.sa: सा प्रस्खलन्ती मदविह्वलाक्षी प्रलम्बकाञ्चीगुण हेमसूत्रा। सलक्षणा लक्ष्मणसन्निधानं जगाम तारा नमिताङ्गयष्टिः।।4.33.38।।
304.e: Tara, whose eyes were drowsy with drink, whose long gold string of the girdle was hanging loose appeared before Lakshmana with faltering steps and bent low, bashful of her appearance. (It suggests a state of exhaustion after sexual pleasures).

304.sa: स तां समीक्ष्यैव हरीशपन्तीं तस्थावुदासीनतया महात्मा। अवाङ्मुखोऽभून्मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रः स्त्रीसन्निकर्षाद्विनिवृत्तकोपः।।4.33.39।।
304.e: Since prince Lakshmana is a great man, he stood with his face down and showing no reaction, controlled his anger due to the presence of a female standing close by.

304.sa: सा पानयोगाद्विनिवृत्तलज्जा दृष्टिप्रसादाच्च नरेन्द्रसूनोः। उवाच तारा प्रणयप्रगल्भं वाक्यं महार्थं परिसान्त्वपूर्वम्।।4.33.40।।
304.e: Setting aside her shyness for being in a drunken state, and observing Lakshmana's favourable disposition, she spoke meaningful words in a pleasing manner with friendly eloquence:

304.sa: किं कोपमूलं मनुजेन्द्रपुत्र कस्ते न सन्तिष्ठति वाङ्निदेशे। क श्शुष्कवृक्षं वनमापतन्तं दवाग्निमासीदति निर्विशङ्कः।।4.33.41।।
304.e: 'O noble prince what is the cause of your anger? Who has disrespected your command? Who can approach without fear forest fire rushing towards a thicket of dried pieces of wood?'

304.sa: स तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा सान्त्वपूर्वमशङ्कितम्। भूयः प्रणयदृष्टार्थं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।4.33.42।।
304.e: Having heard Tara's unhesitant submission spoken in a pleasant and friendly manner, Lakshmana replied:

304.sa: किमयं कामवृत्तस्ते लुप्तधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहः। भर्ता भर्तृहिते युक्ते न चैनमवबुद्ध्यसे।।4.33.43।।
304.e: 'O lady, your husband engrossed in sensual pleasures, has lost sight of dharma and artha. Why don't you understand it in the interest of your husband whose wellwisher you are?

304.sa: न चिन्तयति राज्यार्थं नास्मान् शोकपरायणान्। सामात्यपरिषत्तारे पानमेवोपसेवते।।4.33.44।।
304.e: 'O Tara that we are in grief Sugriva does not realize. He is not attending to state affairs. He is only enjoying drinking in the company of ministers.

304.sa: स मासांश्चतुरः कृत्वा प्रमाणं प्लवगेश्वरः। व्यतीतां स्तान्मदव्यग्रो विहरन्नावबुध्यते।।4.33.45।।
304.e: 'The king of monkeys has already spent four months, enjoying drinks. He does not realize that he has flouted his promise.

304.sa: न हि धर्मार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं पानमेवं प्रशस्यते। पानादर्थश्च धर्मश्च कामश्च परिहीयते।।4.33.46।।
304.e: 'Drinking this way does not help accomplishment of dharma and artha. It destroys wealth, ambition and righteousness.

304.sa: धर्मलोपो महांस्तावत्कृते ह्यप्रतिकुर्वतः। अर्थलोपश्च मित्रस्य नाशे गुणवतो महान्।।4.33.47।।
304.e: 'Dharma is violated when we help not one who has helped. Loss of a virtuous friend leads to great loss of wealth. It results in destruction.

304.sa: मित्रं ह्यर्थगुणश्रेष्ठं सत्यधर्मपरायणम्। तद्द्वयं तु परित्यक्तं न तु धर्मे व्यवस्थितम्।।4.33.48।।
तदेवं प्रस्तुते कार्ये कार्यमस्माभिरुत्तरम्। यत्कार्यं कार्यतत्त्वज्ञे तदुदाहर्तुमर्हसि।।4.33.49।।
304.e: 'You have a strong sense of duty. You ought to tell him his duty and what we should do in this situation.

304.sa: सा तस्य धर्मार्थसमाधियुक्तं निशम्य वाक्यं मधुरस्वभावम्। तारा गतार्थे मनुजेन्द्रकार्ये विश्वासयुक्तं तमुवाच भूयः।।4.33.50।।
304.e: Tara heard the sweet words of Lakshmana which showed his good understanding of dharma and artha. What she said to him in reply reflects her faith in Sugriva's effort to help Rama's cause:

304.sa: न कोपकालः क्षितिपालपुत्र न चाति कोप स्स्वजने विधेयः। त्वदर्थकामस्य जनस्य तस्य प्रमादमप्यर्हसि वीर सोढुम्।।4.33.51।।
304.e: 'O prince this is not the time to get angry with your own people. He (Sugriva) is your friend and wishes to do your work. You should bear with him even if he makes a mistake.

304.sa: कोपं कथं नाम गुणप्रकृष्टः कुमार कुर्यादपकृष्टसत्त्वे। कस्त्वद्विधः कोपवशं हि गच्छे त्सत्त्वावरुद्धस्तपसः प्रसूतिः।।4.33.52।।
304.e: 'O prince how can you, richly endowed with virtues be angry with an inferior person? How can a person like you, preeminent in virtues,and a source of great penance fall a victim to anger?

304.sa: जानामि रोषं हरिवीरबन्धो र्जानामि कार्यस्य च कालसङ्गम्। जानामि कार्यं त्वयि यत्कृतं न स्तच्चापि जानामि यदत्र कार्यम्।।4.33.53।।
304.e: 'I know about the anger of (Rama), the friend of Sugriva. I am aware of the time limit set for his work. I am aware of our omissions in this regard. I also know about the mission.

304.sa: तच्चापि जानामि यथविषह्यं बलं नरश्रेष्ठ शरीरजस्य। जानामि यस्मिंश्च जनेऽवबद्धं कामेन सुग्रीवमसक्तमद्य।।4.33.54।।
304.e: 'O Lakshmana I am aware of the irresistible strength of lust born out of the body. I am aware of Sugriva's indifference to his duty due to his  passion with whomsoever it be.

304.sa: न कामतन्त्रे तव बुद्धिरस्ति त्वं वै यथा मन्युवशं प्रपन्नः। न देशकालौ हि न चार्थधर्मा ववेक्षते कामरतिर्मनुष्यः।।4.33.55।।
304.e: 'You are under the grip of anger and your mind is not involved in carnal desire. One who is engaged in sensual pleasures does not reckon time and place, nor does he consider artha and dharma.

304.sa: तं कामवृत्तं मम सन्निकृष्टं कामाभियोगाच्च निवृत्तलज्जम्। क्षमस्व तावत्परवीरहन्त स्त्वद्भ्रातरं वानरवंशनाथम्।।4.33.56।।
304.e: 'O slayer of enemy heroes pardon Sugriva, the lord of vanara clan, who is to you a brother. He is here indulging in sports of love with me. He has no sense of shame about his passion.

304.sa: महर्षयो धर्मतपोऽभिकामाः कामानुकामाः प्रतिबद्धमोहाः। अयं प्रकृत्या चपलः कपिस्तु कथं न सज्जेत सुखेषु राजा।।4.33.57।।
304.e: 'Even sages committed to piety and austerity are sometimes deluded by sensual gratification. He is a king and a monkey who is fickle by nature. How can he be not tempted by sensual pleasures'?

304.sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महार्थं सा वानरी लक्ष्मणमप्रमेयम्। पुन स्सखेदं मदविह्वलञ्च भर्तुर्हितं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे।।4.33.58।।
304.e: Overcome by drunkenness, Tara once again spoke to Lakshmana of unfathomable prowess, in a meaningful way keeping in view the welfare of her playful and drunken lord:

304.sa: उद्योगस्तु चिराज्ञप्त स्सुग्रीवेण नरोत्तम। कामस्यापि विधेयेन तवार्थप्रतिसाधने।।4.33.59।।
304.e: 'O best of men although overpowered by sense pleasures, Sugriva has already initiated efforts for the accomplishment of your work.

304.sa: आगता हि महावीर्या हरयः कामरूपिणः। कोटीशतसहस्राणि नानानगनिवासिनः।।4.33.60।।
304.e: 'O great warrior monkeys residing at different mountains who can assume any form they like have arrived in hundreds and thousands of crores.

304.sa: तदागच्छ महाबाहो चारित्रं रक्षितं त्वया। अच्छलं मित्रभावेन सतां दारावलोकनम्।।4.33.61।।
304.e: 'O longarmed one  come in. You have been standing out guarding your character. It is not a mistake to see the wife of a pious person with a friendly feeling.

304.sa: तारया चाभ्यनुज्ञातस्त्वरया चापि चोदितः। प्रविवेश महाबाहुरभ्यन्तरमरिन्दमः।।4.33.62।।
304.e: Strongarmed Lakshmana, a subduer of enemies, permitted by Tara entered the harem immediately (thinking of the urgency of the task).

304.sa: तत स्सुग्रीवमासीनं काञ्चने परमासने। महार्हास्तरणोपेते ददर्शादित्यसन्निभम्।।4.33.63।। दिव्याभणचित्राङ्गं दिव्यरूपं यशस्विनम्। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं महेन्द्रमिव दुर्जयम्।।4.33.64।। दिव्याभरणमालाभिः प्रमदाभि स्समावृतम्। संरब्धतररक्ताक्षो बभूवान्तकसन्निभः।।4.33.65।।
304.e: Lakshmana saw famous Sugriva, difficult to be conquered, seated on a golden throne strewn around with cushions, decorated with ornaments of different colours, endearing in appearance, decked with beautiful garlands and clothes. He was surrounded by women adorned with most fascinating ornaments and garlands. Bewildered at the sight, Lakshmana's eyes turned red in anger. He appeared like Yama, lord of death.

304.sa: तत स्सुग्रीवमासीनं काञ्चने परमासने। महार्हास्तरणोपेते ददर्शादित्यसन्निभम्।।4.33.63।। दिव्याभणचित्राङ्गं दिव्यरूपं यशस्विनम्। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं महेन्द्रमिव दुर्जयम्।।4.33.64।। दिव्याभरणमालाभिः प्रमदाभि स्समावृतम्। संरब्धतररक्ताक्षो बभूवान्तकसन्निभः।।4.33.65।।
304.e: Lakshmana saw famous Sugriva, difficult to be conquered, seated on a golden throne strewn around with cushions, decorated with ornaments of different colours, endearing in appearance, decked with beautiful garlands and clothes. He was surrounded by women adorned with most fascinating ornaments and garlands. Bewildered at the sight, Lakshmana's eyes turned red in anger. He appeared like Yama, lord of death.

304.sa: तत स्सुग्रीवमासीनं काञ्चने परमासने। महार्हास्तरणोपेते ददर्शादित्यसन्निभम्।।4.33.63।। दिव्याभणचित्राङ्गं दिव्यरूपं यशस्विनम्। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं महेन्द्रमिव दुर्जयम्।।4.33.64।। दिव्याभरणमालाभिः प्रमदाभि स्समावृतम्। संरब्धतररक्ताक्षो बभूवान्तकसन्निभः।।4.33.65।।
304.e: Lakshmana saw famous Sugriva, difficult to be conquered, seated on a golden throne strewn around with cushions, decorated with ornaments of different colours, endearing in appearance, decked with beautiful garlands and clothes. He was surrounded by women adorned with most fascinating ornaments and garlands. Bewildered at the sight, Lakshmana's eyes turned red in anger. He appeared like Yama, lord of death.

305.sa: तमप्रतिहतं क्रुद्धं प्रविष्टं पुरुषर्षभम्। सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः।।4.34.1।।
305.e: On seeing the angry Lakshmana, a bull among men, who could not be obstructed,  enter in,  Sugriva was disturbed.

305.sa: क्रुद्धं निश्श्वसमानं तं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तं दृष्ट्वा दशरथात्मजम्।।4.34.2।। उत्पपात हरिश्रेष्ठो हित्वा सौवर्णमासनम्। महान्महेन्द्रस्य यथा स्वलङ्कृत इव ध्वजः।।4.34.3।।
305.e: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, son of Dasaratha, sighing heavily, glowing like bright fire burning with the sorrow of Rama, Sugriva jumped out of his seat quitting the decorated golden throne just as Indra's decorated banner is raised up suddenly.

305.sa: क्रुद्धं निश्श्वसमानं तं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तं दृष्ट्वा दशरथात्मजम्।।4.34.2।। उत्पपात हरिश्रेष्ठो हित्वा सौवर्णमासनम्। महान्महेन्द्रस्य यथा स्वलङ्कृत इव ध्वजः।।4.34.3।।
305.e: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, son of Dasaratha, sighing heavily, glowing like bright fire burning with the sorrow of Rama, Sugriva jumped out of his seat quitting the decorated golden throne just as Indra's decorated banner is raised up suddenly.

305.sa: उत्पतन्तमनूत्पेतू रुमाप्रभृतयः स्त्रियः। सुग्रीवं गगने पूर्णचन्द्रं तारागणा इव।।4.34.4।।
305.e: As soon as Sugriva jumped up ,Ruma and other womenfolk rose to their feet like the clusters of stars around the fullMoon in the sky.

305.sa: संरक्तनयनः श्रीमान्विचचाल कृताञ्जलिः। बभूवावस्थितस्तत्र कल्पवृक्षो महानिव।।4.34.5।।
305.e: With eyes red as blood through drunkenness,prosperous Sugriva was shaken like the Kalpa tree.He stood there and offered salutations(to Lakshmana) with folded hands.

305.sa: रुमाद्वितीयं सुग्रीवं नारीमध्यगतं स्थितम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धस्सतारं शशिनं यथा।।4.34.6।।
305.e: Looking at Sugriva surrounded by Ruma and other women like the Moon among stars, infuriated Lakshmana said

305.sa: सत्त्वाभिजनसम्पन्नस्सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः। कृतज्ञस्सत्यवादी च राजा लोके महीयते।।4.34.7।।
305.e: 'Only a king who is an heir to a noble family, compassionate, and selfcontrolled, grateful and truthful excels in the world.

305.sa: यस्तु राजा स्थितोऽधर्मे मित्राणामुपकारिणाम्। मिथ्या प्रतिज्ञां कुरुते को नृशंसतरस्ततः।।4.34.8।।
305.e: 'Which king can be more malicious than the one who makes false promises and adopts an unrighteous path towards those who helped him?

305.sa: शतमश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं तु गवानृते। आत्मानं स्वजनं हन्ति पुरुषः पुरुषानृते।।4.34.9।।
305.e: 'If a man tells a lie about a horse, he commits the sin of killing a hundred horses. If one tells a lie about a cow, he shares the sin of killing a thousand cows. If one tells a lie about a man, it is equal to the sin of killing oneself and his own people.

305.sa: पूर्वं कृतार्थो मित्राणां न तत्प्रतिकरोति यः। कृतघ्नस्सर्वभूतानां स वध्यः प्लवगेश्वर।।4.34.10।।
305.e: 'O lord of monkeys he who, having accomplished his task first with the help of his friend, does not return the help is ungrateful. Such a person deserves to be killed.It applies to all beings.

305.sa: गीतोऽयं ब्रह्मणा श्लोक स्सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः। दृष्ट्वा कृतघ्नं क्रुद्धेन तन्निबोध प्लवङ्गम।।4.34.11।।
305.e: 'O lord of the monkeys here is a verse worthy of appreciation by all the worlds, sung by a brahmin, when he saw an ungrateful person. Listen:

305.sa: ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चोरे भग्नव्रते तथा। निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भि: कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः।।4.34.12।।
305.e: 'There is expiation for one who kills a brahmin, a drunkard, a thief and a violator of sacred vows. But there is no atonement for an ungrateful man.'

305.sa: अनार्यस्त्वं कृतघ्नश्च मिथ्यावादी च वानर। पूर्वं कृतार्थो रामस्य न तत्प्रतिकरोषि यत्।।4.34.13।।
305.e: 'O monkey you have already achieved your objective (with the help of Rama) but have not helped Rama in return. You are surely an ignoble and ungrateful liar.

305.sa: ननु नाम कृतार्थेन त्वया रामस्य वानर। सीताया मार्गणे यत्नः कर्तव्यः कृतमिच्छता।।4.34.14।।
305.e: 'O monkey, if you are grateful to Rama you should wish to search for Sita. Indeed, you should make efforts to take it up.

305.sa: स त्वं ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु सक्तो मिथ्याप्रतिश्रवः। न त्वां रामो विजानीते सर्पं मण्डूकराविणम्।।4.34.15।।
305.e: 'You have failed to keep your word. You are engaged in worldly pleasures. Rama did not know that you are a serpent croaking like a frog.

305.sa: महाभागेन रामेण पापः करुणवेदिना। हरीणां प्रापितो राज्यं त्वं दुरात्मा महात्मना।।4.34.16।।
305.e: 'Rama is illustrious, compassionate and great. He has granted the kingdom to you, to one who is a sinner and an evilminded person.

305.sa: कृतं चेन्नाभिजानीषे रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। सद्यस्त्वं निशितैर्भावार्हतो द्रक्ष्यसि वालिनम्।।4.34.17।।
305.e: 'If you do not recognise  the help of Rama who can accomplish any deed with ease, you will be killed with my sharp arrows and meet Vali (in heaven).

305.sa: न च सङ्कुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः। समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालिपथमन्वगाः।।4.34.18।।
305.e: 'O Sugriva the path by which Vali went is not closed.I wish you do not follow him. You stand by the promise made.

305.sa: न नूनमिक्ष्वाकुवरस्य कार्मुक च्युतान् शरान्पश्यसि वज्र सन्निभान्। तत स्सुखं नाम निषेवसे सुखी। न रामकार्यं मनसाऽप्यवेक्षसे।।4.34.19।।
305.e: 'You have not seen the thunderboltlike arrows released from the bow of Rama, the renowned prince of the Ikshvaku race. Therefore you are resorting to enjoyment without any fear and have not given thought to Rama's work.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfourth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

306.sa: तथा ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं तारा ताराधिपनिभानना।।4.35.1।।
306.e: While Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra, was glowing like fire with his brilliance, thus spoke the moonfaced Tara:

306.sa: नैवं लक्ष्मण वक्तव्यो नायं परुषमर्हति। हरीणामीश्वरश्श्रोतुं तव वक्त्राद्विशेषतः।।4.35.2।।
306.e: 'O Lakshmana you, in particular, should not speak to the king of vanaras in that manner. He does not deserve to hear from your mouth words which are harsh.

306.sa: नैवाकृतज्ञस्सुग्रीवो न शठो नापि दारुणः। नैवानृतकथो वीर न जिह्मश्च कपीश्वरः।।4.35.3।।
306.e: 'O hero Sugriva, king of monkeys, is not ungrateful or deceitful, He is neither crooked nor false.

306.sa: उपकारं कृतं वीरो नाप्ययं विस्मृतः कपिः। रामेण वीर सुग्रीवो यदन्यैर्दुष्करं रणे।।4.35.4।।
306.e: 'O hero this warrior Sugriva has not forgotten the help rendered by Rama in combat which was difficult (to win).

306.sa: रामप्रसादात्कीर्तिञ्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। प्राप्तवानिह सुग्रीवो रुमां मां च परन्तप ।।4.35.5।।
306.e: 'O scorcher of enemies it is by Rama's grace that Sugriva has attained fame, the kingdom of monkeys and Ruma and me.

306.sa: सुदुःखं शयितः पूर्वं प्राप्येदं सुखमुत्तमम्। प्राप्तकालं न जानीते विश्वामित्रो यथा मुनिः।।4.35.6।।
306.e: 'Sleep did not come to him in deep distress in the past, and now that great happiness has come, he does not realize that it is time to act (search for Sita). He behaves like sage Viswamitra.

306.sa: घृताच्यां किल संसक्तो दशवर्षाणि लक्ष्मण। अहोऽमन्यत धर्मात्मा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः।।4.35.7।।
306.e: 'O Lakshmana great sage Visvamitra was in union with an apsara Gritachi for ten years and felt it was just one day indeed

306.sa: स हि प्राप्तं न जानीते कालं कालविदां वरः। विश्वामित्रो महातेजाः किं पुनर्यः पृथग्जनः।।4.35.8।।
306.e: 'If the brilliant and the most distinguished of those who knew the value of time did not realise the passing of time, what can be said of an ordinary person?

306.sa: देहधर्मं गतस्यास्य परिश्रान्तस्य लक्ष्मण। अवितृप्तस्य कामेषु कामं क्षन्तुमिहार्हसि।।4.35.9।।
306.e: 'O Lakshmana you should pardon him since he is not yet satisfied, though tired, with the struggle for the fulfilment of his sensual pleasures.

306.sa: न च रोषवशं तात गन्तुमर्हसि लक्ष्मण। निश्चयार्थमविज्ञाय सहसा प्राकृतो यथा।।4.35.10।।
306.e: 'O dear Lakshmana not knowing the true intention of Sugriva, it is not proper for you to be rashly angry like an ordinary man.

306.sa: सत्त्वयुक्ता हि पुरुषास्त्वद्विधाः पुरुषर्षभ। अविमृश्य न रोषस्य सहसा यान्ति वश्यताम्।।4.35.11।।
306.e: 'O bull among men men with right vision like you do not become angry instantly without right thinking.

306.sa: प्रसादये त्वां धर्मज्ञ सुग्रीवार्थे समाहिता। महान्रोषसमुत्पन्न स्संरम्भस्त्यज्यतामयम्।।4.35.12।।
306.e: 'O Lakshmana, knower of dharma, give up your agitation arising out of great anger. Be composed for the sake of Sugriva.

306.sa: रुमां मां कपि राज्यं च धनधान्यवसूनि च। रामप्रियार्थं सुग्रीवस्त्यजेदिति मतिर्मम।।4.35.13।।
306.e: 'I feel Sugriva should (is prepared to) renounce the monkeykingdom, wealth, grains and other treasures and even Ruma and me for the pleasure of Rama.

306.sa: समानेष्यति सुग्रीव स्सीतया सह राघवम्। शशाङ्कमिव रोहिण्या निहत्वा रावणं रणे।।4.35.14।।
306.e: 'Killing Ravana in war, Sugriva will restore Sita soon to Rama.Rama will join Sita like Moon joins Rohini.

306.sa: शतकोटिसहस्राणि लङ्कायां किल राक्षसाः। आयुतानि च षट्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि शतानि च।।4.35.15।।
